title: Help and Support are in every menu: public header, Space console, platform admin, avatar menu
detail: Owner ask 2026-10-22. Audit found Help already in the member footer, member site menu, phone More sheet and platform admin footer. Gaps closed: the public header row gains Help (DIRECT_LINKS, also the phone sheet), the Space console top bar and phone More sheet gain Contact support (/support), the platform admin top bar gains Support inbox (/admin/support, only when the viewer can see it), and the avatar menu row reads Help & support.
